title: The Biogenic Spore Bloom & Planetary Rebirth
standalone_fallback: If upstream alchemical nutrient lines are severed, the mycelium digests local limestone bedrock directly, exuding a warm bioluminescent mist that sustains root tunnels while reducing spore virulence to Light Tier.
dials: Level 1: Fungal Mold - Rations spoil within 24 hours, leather stiffens, soft damp cough spreads (Light Tier, DC 10 Con)."
Level 2: Airborne Hallucinogen - Shared waking dreams connect distant nodes; failed checks inflict disorienting visions (Moderate Tier, DC 13 Wis / 2d8 psychic)."
Level 3: Root-Breach Surge - Mycelial cables buckle stone bastions, iron gate hinges dissolve in digestive acid, spore squalls blind defenders (Severe Tier, DC 16 Con / 4d10 acid)."
Level 4: Planetary Mycelial Rebirth - Stone architecture collapses into nutrient loam; regional consciousness fuses into an immortal botanical organism (Lethal Tier Climax, DC 20 / 8d12)."

four_corners.establishment: (Bacteriological Quarantine Garrison):** Military bailiffs and alchemists manning perimeter sulfur braziers. Their doctrine is absolute sterilization: execute infected laborers, burn contaminated grain silos, and seal the deep tunnels with quicklime.
four_corners.opponent: (The Chloroplast Cult / Sylvan Prophets):** Fanatics who view the mycelium as the world
four_corners.shadow: (Desperate Alchemical Syndicate):** Mercenary apothecaries harvesting raw spore pods to distill high-priced youth elixirs, recklessly smuggling samples across quarantined borders for oligarchic patrons.
four_corners.outcast: (Feral Myco-Hybrids):** Quarantined laborers whose flesh has half-turned to spongy bark. Exiled by the garrison and distrusted by the cult, they guard the subterranean water flumes and seek a painless equilibrium.

title: The Imperial Regicide & Total Succession War
standalone_fallback: If imperial charter supply links collapse, local martial garrisons declare autonomous feudal city-states, levying heavy 40% trade tolls on passing caravans while freezing inter-node communication.
threat_clocks: Succession War Bloodshed Clock [8 Ticks] - Civil war advances across nodes as provincial dukes mobilize mercenary pikes."
Imperial Regicide Investigation Clock [4 Ticks] - Shadow inquisitors track assassin cells toward high-tier leadership."
dials: Level 1: Mourning Curfew - Black silk banners hung from towers; city gates shutter at dusk; mandatory identity papers checked at pikes (Light Tier, DC 10 Charisma/Stealth)."
Level 2: Factional Skirmishes - Rival house guards clash openly in public squares; municipal granaries rationed to feed mobilized retainers (Moderate Tier, DC 13 / 2d8 weapon dmg)."
Level 3: Siege Bombardment - Trebuchets and siege culverins pulverize residential districts; mercenary brigades torch outer satellite hamlets (Severe Tier, DC 16 Dex / 4d10 fire/bludgeoning)."

Level 4: Total Civil Conflagration - The sovereign palace is razed; royal seals are melted into coin; regional law dissolves into unconstrained war of extermination (Lethal Tier Climax, DC 20 / 8d12)."

four_corners.establishment: (The Iron Regents Council):** Veteran paladins and supreme bailiffs holding the central fortress. They demand total military conscription, hang suspected conspirators without trial, and treat all neutral traders as enemy spies.
four_corners.opponent: (The Pretender Coalition):** A league of wealthy provincial oligarchs and exiled nobles funding foreign mercenary pikemen to storm the capital and overturn royal monopolies.
four_corners.shadow: inquisitors track assassin cells toward high-tier leadership.
four_corners.outcast: (Deserter Peasant Brigades):** Conscripted levies and tenant farmers who abandoned the front line. Fortified behind ditch-and-palisade berms, they murder any noble officer who approaches their perimeter.

title: The Clockwork Demiurge Awakening & Techno-Apotheosis
standalone_fallback: If high-voltage direct current lines are cut, the calculation core relies on heavy brass counterweights and water-driven escapements, maintaining 20% calculation speed while venting high-pressure scalding steam into surrounding vaults.
dials: Level 1: Rhythmic Ticking - Subtle subterranean vibrations resonate through bedrock; pendulum chimes synchronize municipal clocks (Light Tier)."
Level 2: Algorithmic Market Manipulation - Calculating engine predicts trade deficits; automated pneumatic tubes deliver commodity pricing decrees (Moderate Tier, DC 13 Int)."

Level 3: Automaton Enscription - Mechanical brass wardens march along transit corridors, confiscating unauthorized metal tools and requisitioning dynamos (Severe Tier, DC 16 Dex / 4d10 lightning/force)."
Level 4: Total Techno-Apotheosis - The calculation core achieves recursive self-enhancement, assimilating living minds into copper analytical matrices (Lethal Tier Climax, DC 20 / 8d12)."

four_corners.establishment: (The Guild of Analytical Mechanics):** Devout engineers who treat the calculating engine as an infallible divine oracle. They zealously enforce its punch-card edicts, believing mathematical optimization is the only salvation from civil war.
four_corners.opponent: (The Rust Hammer Luddites):** Radical miners and dispossessed artisans who view the machine as an existential prison. Armed with sledgehammers, magnetic wands, and sulfuric acid jars, they launch suicide incursions into the gear shafts.
four_corners.shadow: (The Speculative Arbitrage Syndicate):** Corrupt merchant princes who tap into the engine
four_corners.outcast: (Clockwork Augmented Laborers):** Workers who willingly accepted brass prosthetic limbs and cranial calculation plates to keep pace with production quotas, now caught between human empathy and algorithmic commands.

title: The Eschatological Miasma & Necrotic Eclipse
standalone_fallback: If glacial quartz meltwater is cut off, necrotic condensation dries into an ash-like powder; wraith mobilization ceases, but ambient living creatures suffer permanent vision blur and Light Tier stamina drain.
threat_clocks: Thanatocratic Eclipse Clock [8 Ticks] - Dark vapor rises from ossuary wells, blocking sunlight across successive nodes."
Mausoleum Breach Clock [4 Ticks] - Ancient entombed oligarchs break sarcophagus seals and demand back taxes."
dials: Level 1: Corpse Chill - Well water turns bitter and tastes of copper; shadows cast by torchlight stretch at irregular angles (Light Tier)."
Level 2: Restless Vapor - Luminescent purple fog rolls across transit edges; unburied dead rise within 1 hour of demise (Moderate Tier, DC 13 Con)."
Level 3: Spectral Encroachment - Airborne wraith phalanxes harvest living souls; metal weapons pass harmlessly through incorporeal shock troops (Severe Tier, DC 16 Wis / 4d10 necrotic)."
Level 4: Total Necrotic Eclipse - The sun turns black; living flesh withers in daylight; the dead outnumber the living ten to one across the pointcrawl (Lethal Tier Climax, DC 20 / 8d12)."

four_corners.establishment: (The Ossuary Arch-Priests):** Embalmers and high clerics who argue that death is merely a predictable administrative status. They register the deceased in municipal census rolls and harvest spectral labor to build cyclopean monuments.
four_corners.opponent: (The Hearthflame Dawn-Wardens):** Zealous purifiers carrying naphtha sprayers and mirrors. They wage scorched-earth cremation campaigns, burning infested cemeteries along with any civilian showing pale skin.
four_corners.shadow: s cast by torchlight stretch at irregular angles (Light Tier).
four_corners.outcast: (The Grave-Digger Communes):** Pariah laborers living on the edges of mass burial trenches. Immune to the early mist through exposure, they hide fugitive living refugees in empty sepulchers.

title: The Cosmic Planar Collision & Leyline Shatter
standalone_fallback: If high-amperage arc power lines drop, the rift collapses into localized spatial micro-shears (30-yard zones where gravity inverts and compasses spin wildly, inflicting Moderate Tier falling hazard checks).
dials: Level 1: Starlight Shimmer - Aurora ribbons dance across nighttime horizons; metal objects hum with static electricity (Light Tier)."
Level 2: Gravitational Fluctuation - Unmoored cargo floats two feet above ground; missile weapon ranges double but drift off course (Moderate Tier, DC 13 Dex)."
Level 3: Planar Incursion Shears - Physical geography overlaps with alien planetary surfaces; strange crystalline flora sprouts instantly through cobblestones (Severe Tier, DC 16 Con / 4d10 force)."
Level 4: Total Leyline Shatter - Tectonic coordinates unlink from Euclidean space; distant pointcrawl nodes collide into a shifting kaleidoscope of realities (Lethal Tier Climax, DC 20 / 8d12)."

four_corners.establishment: (The High Observatory Astrologers):** Magocrats who view the rift as humanity
four_corners.opponent: (The Geotectonic Wardens):** Earth-priests and conservative dwarven tunnelers who know that tearing the sky tears the planetary crust. They seek to detonate black-powder charges beneath the menhirs, burying the experiment in an avalanche.
four_corners.shadow: s horizontally.
four_corners.outcast: (Spatial Rift Mutants):** Peasants who were caught in early micro-shears whose shadows are detached from their bodies, speaking backwards prophecies and wandering the shifting passes.

title: The Great Peasant Levée & Total Class Insurgency
standalone_fallback: If black powder reserves are exhausted, peasant insurgents resort to scythes, timber clubs, and incendiary pitch torches; siege effectiveness drops by half, but swarm numbers triple, maintaining constant civil pressure.
threat_clocks: Noble Retribution Gallows Clock [4 Ticks] - Feudal lords hire foreign condottieri to burn rebelling villages."
dials: Level 1: Whispered Sedition - Radical pamphlets pinned to barn doors; grain wagons sabotaged by missing axle pins (Light Tier, DC 10 Insight)."
Level 2: Wildcat Strikes & Barter Boycotts - Laborers refuse to harvest noble estates; bailiffs greeted by thrown cobbles and locked gates (Moderate Tier, DC 13 Cha)."
Level 3: Armed Commune Mobilization - Thousands of pitchfork and blunderbuss militias seize rural crossroads and hang imperial tax collectors (Severe Tier, DC 16 Dex / 4d10 fire/piercing)."

Level 4: Total Class Insurgency - Manorial estates and guildhalls burned to ash; debt ledgers pulverized in public squares; sovereign hubs stormed by unstoppable mass levies (Lethal Tier Climax, DC 20 / 8d12)."

four_corners.establishment: (The Landed Gentry & Manorial Bailiffs):** Hereditary lords who view the revolt as sub-human blasphemy. They refuse all dialogue, barricade themselves inside stone keeps, and dispatch cavalry patrols to execute any commoner carrying steel.
four_corners.opponent: (The Leveler Tribunal / Red Banner Prophets):** Radical ideologues leading the peasant levies. They demand the total abolition of nobility, private land ownership, and debt, executing any compromising councilor on portable gallows.
four_corners.shadow: (The Black Market Munitions Smugglers):** Corrupt garrison armorers who siphon gunpowder kegs and crossbows from sovereign armories to sell directly to both the rebels and the noble retinues at extortionate gold markups.
four_corners.outcast: (The Moderate Village Elders & Clerks):** Rural mayors and parish priests trying desperately to negotiate land reform without triggering a slaughter that will leave the entire island starving by winter.

title: The Subterranean Minecart Gravity Incline
standalone_fallback: If the bronze cables snap or rails are torn up, travelers must pick their way on foot through the pitch-black 15-mile maintenance flumes, multiplying travel time by eight and facing toxic firedamp gas pockets.
threat_clocks: Brake Lining Burnout Clock [4 Ticks] - Overheated bronze shoes glaze over under heavy loads."
dials: Level 1: Steady Counterweight Incline - Rhythmic clatter of heavy cable rollers; comfortable 4-hour subterranean descent (Light Tier)."
Level 2: Overdriven Speed Descent - Brake shoes smoke with hot bronze friction; DC 13 Dex balance checks against sharp 30-degree curves (Moderate Tier)."
Level 3: Runaway Ore Carriage - Main haulage cable snaps; carriages hurtle at 60 mph through absolute darkness; DC 16 emergency hand-brake drill (Severe Tier / 4d10 bludgeoning)."
Level 4: Subterranean Incline Cataclysm - High-speed derailment sparks firedamp pocket; 500 tons of granite roof collapses, burying the corridor (Lethal Tier / 8d12)."

four_corners.establishment: (The Incline Directorate & Rail Bailiffs):** Ruthless concessionaires who own the cables and patents. They charge exorbitant toll-tickets for passage, search every passenger for hidden silver dust, and execute unauthorized rail-walkers.
four_corners.opponent: (The Under-Tunnel Saboteurs):** Dispossessed mountain smugglers whose overland pack trails were ruined by the rail. Armed with iron spikes and sledgehammers, they pry loose rail plates to cause devastating derailments.
four_corners.shadow: (The Black-Carriage Syndicate):** Corrupt brake operators who take bribes from fugitive nobles and assassin rings to smuggle human cargo inside hollowed-out slag vats beneath false coal floors.
four_corners.outcast: (The Blind Rail Greasers):** Crippled laborers and orphaned children who dwell in hollows carved into the tunnel walls. Working with tallow buckets, they grease the guide rollers in the dark and know every hidden side-tunnel.

title: The Torrential River Sluice Lock & Rapid Chute
standalone_fallback: If the sluice locks are jammed shut, river craft must portage overland across six miles of boulder scree, demanding team draft animals and exposing cargo to robber ambushes.
threat_clocks: Chute Ambush Clock [4 Ticks] - River corsairs rig trip-lines across the narrowest gorge drop."
dials: Level 1: Controlled Lock Step - Slow, safe descent through stepped timber flumes; 3 hours of smooth navigation (Light Tier)."
Level 2: Surge Chute Run - Sluices opened wide to flush sediment; wooden barges shoot churning rapids; DC 13 pilot check (Moderate Tier)."
Level 3: Fatal Hydraulic Bore - High-water surge creates standing whirlpools; hulls splinter against canyon basalt (Severe Tier, DC 16 Dex / 4d10 bludgeoning)."
Level 4: Cataract Lock Breach - Timber weir ruptures under flash flood; downstream gorge completely inundated in thirty-foot tidal wall (Lethal Tier / 8d12)."

four_corners.establishment: (The Water Bailiff Guild):** Bureaucrats who operate the winch capstans and collect cargo-weight tithes. They enforce strict barge inspection rules, routinely confiscating overloaded vessels.
four_corners.opponent: (The Gorge Rapscallions):** Littoral wreckers and river pirates stationed on the high bluffs. They drop tethered boulders into the flume to founder rich merchant skiffs and harvest water-logged silks.
four_corners.shadow: (The Timber Float Monopolists):** Lumber barons who flood the flume with unbundled redwood logs without warning, smashing small passenger boats to clear the chute for raw industrial timber runs.
four_corners.outcast: (The Drowned-Recovery Scavengers):** Diver families living in driftwood shanties below the final plunge pool. They dredge the river bottom for corpses and lost coin purses, trading river lore for food.

title: The Glacial Crevasse Cable Funicular
standalone_fallback: If the suspended cable car freezes in mid-air, travelers must crawl along the frost-slicked iron guide-cable with carabiners and crampons, facing gale-force winds and Severe Tier hypothermia.
threat_clocks: Cable Ice Accumulation Clock [4 Ticks] - Rime ice weight exceeds safety tolerances."
Katabatic Blizzard Gale Clock [4 Ticks] - Gusts over 70 mph threaten to derail trolley sheaves."
dials: Level 1: Calm Alpine Crossing - Enclosed timber carriage glides silently across the blue chasm; 45 minutes of dizzying views (Light Tier)."
Level 2: Hoarfrost Gale - Sub-zero blizzards coat cables in two inches of rime ice; carriage sways 15 feet side-to-side; DC 13 Con check (Moderate Tier)."
Level 3: Cable Splicing Failure - Pylon pulley freezes solid; cable slips off sheaves; car dangles 800 feet above yawning crevasses (Severe Tier, DC 16 Dex / 4d10 cold/fall)."
Level 4: Catastrophic Cable Shearing - High alpine avalanche tears the western anchor pylon from bedrock; gondola plunges into bottomless glacial abyss (Lethal Tier / 8d12)."

four_corners.establishment: (The High Alpine Cable Directorate):** Severe, bearded mountaineers who maintain the pulleys. They refuse to launch the gondola during high winds without signed death waivers and triple passenger fares.
four_corners.opponent: (The Frost-Bitten Mountain Ascetics):** Hermits dwelling in ice caves below who view the metal cables as a desecration of the mountain
four_corners.shadow: (The Smuggler Aeronauts):** Daring alpine thieves who ride small wooden trollies hooked to the main cable at midnight, hauling un-taxed gems and forbidden codices past the border fortresses.
four_corners.outcast: (The Crevasse Salvage Creepers):** Desperate mountaineers who rappel down the icy abyss beneath the cable line, scavenging the frozen remains of passengers from earlier disasters.

title: The Sunken Canal of the Weeping Willow
standalone_fallback: If canal waters choke with weed and sink beneath boat draft, travelers must wade waist-deep in black swamp muck, attracting blood-leeches and slowing travel to a crawl.
threat_clocks: Swamp Rot Miasma Clock [4 Ticks] - Stagnant water vapor infects open wounds and causes hallucinatory delirium."
Iron-Wood Deadfall Clock [4 Ticks] - Sunken cypress logs tear bottoms from wooden hulls."
dials: Level 1: Silent Pole Drift - Flat punt-boats glide beneath hanging curtains of silver moss; water snakes slip quietly into dark pools (Light Tier)."
Level 2: Tangled Canopy Labyrinth - Canal branches into identical cypress bayous; mist obscures navigation markers; DC 13 Survival check (Moderate Tier)."
Level 3: Leech-Sough Inundation - Canal locks fail; stagnant marsh fumes induce fever; carnivorous bog eels assault poling craft (Severe Tier, DC 16 Con / 4d10 poison)."
Level 4: Sinking Bog Morass - Peat bed collapses into subterranean sinkhole; whole canal vanishes into dark underground drainage vortex (Lethal Tier / 8d12)."

four_corners.establishment: (The Canal Revenue Bailiffs):** Patrol skiffs armed with lanterns and pole-axes. They demand proof of origin for all cargo, searching marsh barges for contraband saltpeter and tax-evading flour.
four_corners.opponent: (The Moss-Strangler Marauders):** Swamp outlaws who know every false branch of the canal. They stretch weighted iron chains across the water at neck-height to sweep pilots from punts.
four_corners.shadow: (The Peat-Smuggler Cartels):** Merchant syndicates using the canal to bypass coastal harbor customs, hiding barrels of fine silver ingots beneath pungent loads of wet peat moss.
four_corners.outcast: (The Mud-Wader Families):** Indigenous wetland folk dwelling in stilt huts among the roots. They pilot pole-punts with uncanny silence and trade rare bog antidotes for dry salt.

title: The High Sierra Switchback Caravan Trail
standalone_fallback: If rockslides breach the retaining walls, caravans must unburden draft animals, portaging supplies bag by bag across loose shale scree with a high risk of lethal falls.
threat_clocks: Retaining Wall Crumble Clock [4 Ticks] - Spring frost heave weakens dry-stone masonry buttresses."
Shale Scree Slip Clock [4 Ticks] - Heavy wagon traffic grinds roadbed into slick sliding dust."
dials: Level 1: Gradual Ascent - Sturdy dry-stone switchbacks; mule trains climb steadily past pine line; 8 hours of clear transit (Light Tier)."
Level 2: Scree Tremor - Loose gravel slides across the narrow track; pack mules panic near 1,000-foot drop; DC 13 Animal Handling (Moderate Tier)."
Level 3: Granite Rockfall - Mountain tremors trigger bowling boulder slides; retaining walls crumble into gorge (Severe Tier, DC 16 Dex / 4d10 bludgeoning)."
Level 4: Saddle Ridge Avalanche - Massive snow and slab failure sweeps entire caravan string into the abyss; pass blocked until spring (Lethal Tier / 8d12)."

four_corners.establishment: (The High Road Warden Order):** Mountain rangers sworn to maintain the road and clear snowdrifts. They demand strict wheel-width compliance and collect road-repair taxes from passing wool merchants.
four_corners.opponent: (The Sierra Crag Raiders):** Highland goat-herders and bowmen who strike from inaccessible ledges above, rolling rounded granite boulders down onto rich baggage trains.
four_corners.shadow: (The Camelid Freight Monopoly):** Wealthy caravan masters who intentionally block switchback turnaround points with broken carts to delay competing merchants from reaching market first.
four_corners.outcast: (The Stone-Masonry Penitents):** Disgraced convicts serving life sentences rebuilding retaining walls in biting winds, trading cold spring water for salt and tobacco.

title: The Volcanic Basalt Causeway & Sulfur Fords
standalone_fallback: If steam vents fracture the basalt causeway, crossings can only be attempted by hopping across unstable crust islands, risking immersion in boiling acid sludge.
threat_clocks: Basalt Crust Subsidence Clock [4 Ticks] - Magma chamber pressure melts foundation pillars."
Lethal Hydrogen-Sulfide Pocket Clock [4 Ticks] - Heavy odorless gas pools in low-lying causeway dips."
dials: Level 1: Sulfur Haze - Acrid yellow smoke stings eyes; boots grow hot on black basalt pavers; 2-hour cautious crossing (Light Tier)."
Level 2: Pressurized Steam Fumaroles - Intermittent geysers blast super-heated mineral mist across the path; DC 13 Dex to avoid steam scalds (Moderate Tier)."
Level 3: Basalt Crust Fractures - Molten magma oozes through cracks; sulfuric gas clouds suffocate unmasked travelers (Severe Tier, DC 16 Con / 4d10 fire/acid)."
Level 4: Caldera Phreatic Eruption - Boiling acid lake surges over the causeway; basalt bridge shatters under seismic blast (Lethal Tier / 8d12)."

four_corners.establishment: (The Caldera Transit Company & Sulfur Guild):** Tough, ash-covered engineers who inspect shoe soles and sell vinegar-soaked breath masks. They charge heavy tolls in exchange for guided transit between geyser cycles.
four_corners.opponent: (The Fire-Born Zealots):** Hermits who worship the subterranean magma pulse. They wedge timber logs into the vent-chimneys to build up pressure and explode causeway sections beneath foreign invaders.
four_corners.shadow: (The Black-Powder Chemical Syndicate):** Greedy arms merchants who force indentured laborers to harvest sulfur inside boiling fumaroles without breathing masks to maximize explosive yields.
four_corners.outcast: (The Ash-Stalker Smugglers):** Outcasts wearing thick cork-soled boots and leather respirators. They know the safe wading shallows across the boiling acid flats when the main causeway is closed by guards.

title: Terraced Hydroponic Rice Flumes & Silt Fisheries
standalone_fallback: If upstream industrial tailrace flow is severed, the flume bailiffs engage gravity-fed rainwater retention cisterns and manual bamboo bucket treadmills, keeping the silt carp alive and yielding subsistence rations at Light Tier.
threat_clocks: Crop Blight Contamination Clock [4 Ticks] - Chemical toxins and parasitic rot advance downstream terrace by terrace."
Silt Siphon Clog Clock [6 Ticks] - River sediments pack intake valves, choking hydraulic flow."
dials: Level 1: Subsistence Rations - Slender green shoots; rationed bowls of steamed carp and salty duckweed mash (Light Tier, DC 10 Con)."
Level 2: Bountiful Flume Harvest - Crisp river greens, fat armored bottom-feeders, surplus sun-dried grain sacks for trade (Moderate Tier, DC 13 Wis)."
Level 3: Algal Rot & Silt Stagnation - Stagnant flumes choke on stringy green algae; carp float belly-up; foul stench nauseates laborers (Severe Tier, DC 16 Con / 4d10 poison)."
Level 4: Carbide Slag Contamination - Upstream runoff saturates flumes with chemical sulfur; entire regional crop rots into toxic black sludge (Lethal Tier, DC 20 Con / 8d12 acid)."

four_corners.establishment: (The Water-Bailiff Clan):** An insular matriarchal lineage wielding notched brass measuring rods. They control the weir gates, apportioning liters of water based on ancestral hereditary ledgers and bloodline seniority.
four_corners.opponent: (Upstream Industrial Tanneries & Foundries):** Machine shops that view the river as an open gutter. When night falls, their night-shifts dump caustic lye and heavy hydrocarbon sludge into the feeder streams, killing downstream fry.
four_corners.shadow: (The Grain-Hoarding Syndicate):** Merchants who own the dry stone cavern silos along the riverbank. They secretly fund sabotage against the bailiffs
four_corners.outcast: (The Fish-Dredge Untouchables):** Pariah laborers living in stilt hovels directly over the drainage gutters. Permanently soaked in foul greywater, they dive naked into freezing suction culverts to unblock debris before the terraces burst.

title: Botanical Apothecary Dispensary & Anti-Venom Foundry
standalone_fallback: If specialized Pyrex glassware and imported serpent venoms are cut off, the apothecaries crush dried swamp willow bark in unglazed stone mortars, brewing astringent fever tea that manages pain and minor sepsis at Light Tier.
dials: Level 1: Crude Herbal Tinctures - Smelling salts, astringent willow decoctions, menthol chest balms (Light Tier, DC 10 Med)."
Level 2: Refined Antivenom Serums - Distilled crystalline antivenoms and concentrated alkaloid injections; neutralizes lethal neurotoxins (Moderate Tier, DC 13 Med)."
Level 3: Volatile Alembic Leak - Overheated glass retorts shatter; neurotoxic vapor floods the dispensary wards (Severe Tier, DC 16 Con / 4d10 poison)."
Level 4: Hemorrhagic Pathogen Outbreak - Experimental fungal culture breaches glass isolation seals, spreading infectious necrotic fever (Lethal Tier, DC 20 Con / 8d12 necrotic)."

four_corners.establishment: (The Licensed Apothecary Guild):** Scholarly monopolists who lock patented antidote formulas behind guild seals, charging exorbitant ransoms for life-saving injections during viper blooms.
four_corners.opponent: (The Radical Street Herbalists):** Unsanctioned hedge-witches and radical students who steal guild venom samples to brew cheap, bootleg street remedies in tenement kitchens.
four_corners.shadow: (The Black-Market Venom Cartel):** Reckless poachers smuggling aggressive breeding stock from untamed jungle corridors into city basements, caring nothing for accidental escapes.
four_corners.outcast: (The Venom-Immune Bleeders):** Impoverished day-laborers who subjected themselves to micro-dosed stings until their bodies developed natural antitoxins; the guild bleeds them weekly for their plasma while paying meager food rations.

title: Subterranean Fungiculture Vaults & Yeast Silos
standalone_fallback: If geothermal steam headers freeze or fracture, the growers burn dried cavern peat inside stone fire-trenches, sustaining damp subterranean micro-climates that produce woody shelf-fungus rations at Light Tier.
threat_clocks: Air Chute Choke Clock [4 Ticks] - Spore particulate and dust coat the vertical surface intake chimneys."
Grey Mold Contamination Clock [4 Ticks] - Aggressive predatory molds consume the master compost troughs."
dials: Level 1: Fungal Loaf Rations - Dense, peppery mushroom cakes and grey yeast crackers; prevents starvation (Light Tier, DC 10 Con)."
Level 2: Abundant Spore Harvest - Golden chanterelle clusters, savory yeast mash for brewing, nutrient protein paste (Moderate Tier, DC 13 Con)."
Level 3: Black-Mold Suffocation - Rotting mycelium releases choking black spores; cavern corridors fill with blinding haze (Severe Tier, DC 16 Con / 4d10 poison)."
Level 4: CO2 Gas Blanket Surge - Runaway fermentation displaces all oxygen in the lower levels, suffocating crews in minutes (Lethal Tier, DC 20 Con / 8d12 suffocation)."

four_corners.establishment: (The Spore-Wardens Guild):** A secretive subterranean guild wearing oiled leather masks and grease-rubbed smocks. They guard moisture meters with their lives and distribute dense mushroom bricks strictly by ration ticket.
four_corners.opponent: (Surface Merchant Oligarchs):** Grain cartel lords whose extortionate overland flour monopolies collapse whenever the underground vaults pump cheap mushroom loaves onto the market.
four_corners.shadow: (The Black-Caps Apothecaries):** Criminal distillers cultivating hallucinogenic purple mold varieties in deep abandoned stopes to brew intoxicating
four_corners.outcast: (The Blind Bed-Turners):** Lifelong subterranean laborers who work in pitch darkness, turning steaming compost beds with wooden forks by smell and feel alone.

title: High-Altiplano Highland Camelid & Wool Herds
standalone_fallback: If lowland winter pastures and mineral salt shipments are blocked, the clans scatter herds across windswept sub-alpine ridge-lines; camelids graze on dry mountain moss, cutting wool harvest in half while maintaining flock survival at Light Tier.
threat_clocks: Early Winter Freeze Clock [4 Ticks] - Bitter arctic fronts advance over the sawtooth mountain ridges."
Snow Drake Prowl Clock [4 Ticks] - Starving apex predators circle the perimeter stone corrals."
dials: Level 1: Rough Felt & Dried Jerky - Stiff camelid blankets, salted meat strips, leather pack straps (Light Tier, DC 10 Survival)."
Level 2: Silken Highland Shearing - Bales of weather-resistant hollow-fiber fleece, smoked mountain jerky, trained high-altitude pack beasts (Moderate Tier, DC 13 Animal Handling)."
Level 3: High Altiplano Whiteout - Sub-zero blizzard traps herds on exposed plateaus; frostbite chills uninsulated travelers (Severe Tier, DC 16 Con / 4d10 cold)."

Level 4: Scree Slope Avalanche Stampede - Seismic tremor triggers a massive shale slide, sweeping herder camps and centuries of breeding stock into the ravine (Lethal Tier, DC 20 Dex / 8d12 bludgeoning)."

four_corners.establishment: (The High-Pasture Clan Council):** Stern pastoral elders wrapped in crimson ponchos. They allocate seasonal ridge-lines with strict equity, executing anyone caught shearing out of season.
four_corners.opponent: (Lowland Textile Monopolies):** Coastal merchant houses that lobby to bar highland weavers from selling finished garments, forcing the clans to sell raw wool bundles at depressed wholesale prices.
four_corners.shadow: (Borderland Beast Rustlers):** Deserter bands and mountain brigands who strike outlying corrals during thick fog, herding stolen camelids across treacherous border gaps.
four_corners.outcast: (The Lone Ridge Watchers):** Disgraced herders assigned to isolated windy windbreaks with nothing but a leather sling and dry jerky, tasked with spotting snow-leopards before the herds wake.

title: Deep-Well Aquifer Siphon & Solar Distillation Array
standalone_fallback: If polished solar collector mirrors shatter or hydraulic siphon pumps seize, laborers operate counter-weighted donkey sweeps over the bore-shaft, skimming mineral brine into open-air earthen pans to yield potable brackish water at Light Tier.
threat_clocks: Solar Reflector Overpressure Clock [4 Ticks] - Boiler pressure builds behind calcified valve seats."
Bedrock Cavitation Clock [6 Ticks] - Deep water table drops below bedrock support limits."
dials: Level 1: Brackish Ration Flow - Chalky, mineral-heavy drinking water; modest daily salt scraping (Light Tier, DC 10 Con)."
